reactor_type: laminar-flow-type thermal reactor (NCD, Lucida D100, Korea)
evidence: All the film depositions were performed at a substrate temperature of 120 °C using diethylzinc (DEZ; EG Chem., Korea) as the common precursor for Zn while deionized H2O and 10% hydrogen sulfide (H2S mixed with N2, Gaschem., Korea) gas were used as the reactants for the oxide and sulfide films, respectively.
